import json
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
d=json.load(open('coverage.json'))
print(d['findings'],d['failures'],d['notes'])
files=[f['file'] for f in d['frames']]
W,H=1360,250; s=0.5; cw,ch=int(W*s),int(H*s)+18
per=28
for n in range(0,len(files),per):
    chunk=files[n:n+per]
    sheet=Image.new('RGB',(cw*2,ch*((len(chunk)+1)//2)),(255,0,255))
    dr=ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for i,f in enumerate(chunk):
        im=Image.open(f).convert('RGB').crop((280,0,280+W,H)).resize((cw,ch-18))
        x=(i%2)*cw; y=(i//2)*ch
        sheet.paste(im,(x,y+18)); dr.rectangle((x,y,x+cw,y+18),fill=(0,0,0)); dr.text((x+4,y+3),f,fill=(255,255,0))
    sheet.save(f'/tmp/t/c{n//per}.png')
print(len(files))
EOF
